attribution.data: BANC, the brain and nerve cord connectome of one adult female Drosophila, version 888
attribution.paper: Bates, Phelps, Kim, Yang et al. 2026. Distributed control circuits across a brain-and-cord connectome. Nature. doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10735-w
attribution.changes: Spike counts, first-spike times and routes are this project's model (a leaky integrate-and-fire network after Shiu et al. 2024) run on BANC v888 wiring, or on a sister's copy of it with re-rolled synapse counts; route synapse counts are that wiring's. Nothing here is a BANC measurement.
attribution.names: Cell names and classes come from BANC annotation columns. We have not yet asked BANC's authors whether they fall under the deposit's CC BY 4.0 or under the FlyWire platform's CC BY-NC 4.0 terms; until that is settled, no commercial use of the names.

engine: lab/flybrain/engine_ext.py numba kernel (receipts_run.py), BANC v888 at 0.3 mV, dt 0.1 ms

labels.BRAIN: spikes, first-spike times and synapse counts (this model on BANC v888 wiring, or a sister's rolled copy); cell names and classes (BANC annotations)
labels.REPLAY: every receipt is a re-run of the recorded trial the pet deals; ok = 1 when it reproduced every stored number
labels.DESIGN: route ranking (weakest link, the lab trace rule), the caps, the plain words for each drive set and the body part a muscle cell is drawn on
labels.MODEL: every trial starts from rest (1 s, or 2.6-4 s for the spider), no memory between them; no electrical synapses

fired_bin.layout: uint32 pack index x rows, then uint16 first-spike step (0.1 ms; 65535 unknown) x rows, then uint16 spikes x rows; little-endian; each trial is f = [first row, rows]

driven_bin.layout: uint16 first spike in whole ms (65535: silent) for every cell of each driven set, sets in drv order, cells in drives[set].cells order; each trial starts at dvf

deck.note: the deck files these receipts replay; a deck that holds other trials needs new receipts

bitter_right.say: bitter-taste cells on her right lip
bitter_right.what: right labellar bitter GRNs (roles.py); on her fig's days they stand in for its acid, which excites bitter cells (Charlu et al. 2013)

eye_right.say: touch bristles around her right eye

haltere_left.say: balance sensors on her left haltere

jo_ab_both.what: JO-A and JO-B of both antennae, Johnston's organ (a raindrop's thump)

jo_b_left.say: sound sensors in her left antenna

jo_b_right.say: sound sensors in her right antenna

jon_ce_left.say: touch sensors in her left antenna

jon_ce_right.say: touch sensors in her right antenna

lc4_left.say: looming detectors in her left eye
lc4_left.what: LC4 left (roles.py); a hand drives LC4 only (DESIGN)

lc4_right.say: looming detectors in her right eye
lc4_right.what: LC4 right (roles.py); a hand drives LC4 only (DESIGN)

leg_left.say: touch bristles on her left front leg

leg_sugar_left.say: sugar-taste cells on her left feet

sugar_right.say: sugar-taste cells on her right lip
sugar_right.what: right labellar sugar GRNs, roles.py LB3b+LB3c

water_right.say: water-taste cells on her right lip
water_right.what: right labellar water GRNs, roles.py LB3a

wing_margin_left.say: touch bristles on her left wing edge

wing_margin_right.say: touch bristles on her right wing edge

wing_right.say: touch bristles on her right wing edge

receipt_keys.ok: reproduced every stored number (1) or not (0)
receipt_keys.jd: fingerprint of what this trial was checked against (receipts_jobs.digest): the fly, the drive, the trial and the stored numbers; --restamp needs it unchanged
receipt_keys.drv: [set, top rate Hz, cells, cells that fired, first spike step, drive starts ms, ends ms (null: the whole trial), ramped 1/0] per driven group
receipt_keys.dvf: first value of this trial in driven.bin
receipt_keys.inc: 1 when some first spikes are unknown
receipt_keys.n: [cells active, non-driven cells active, total spikes]
receipt_keys.dv: [driven cells that fired, first driven spike step, driven spikes]
receipt_keys.ro: [cell, spikes, first-spike step] for the cells the pet reads (step -1: silent)
receipt_keys.dm: [cell, spikes, first-spike step] for the DNs and MNs that fired (top 6 by spikes)
receipt_keys.ndm: DNs and MNs that fired in all
receipt_keys.rt: [target cell, weakest synapse count, in first-spike order, then per hop: cell, synapses in (0 on the driven cell), first-spike step]
receipt_keys.cell: an index into cells (its columns); a step is 0.1 ms
